**Severity:** error · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Preact useId mask not applied (probe rendered {html}): Preact island ids would not be unique. This Preact version is not supported by @rivetjs/bridge-preact; update it or pin preact to a supported version.
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Install a Preact version inside `@rivetjs/bridge-preact`'s peer range that the adapter supports (pin `preact` to the last working version), or update `@rivetjs/bridge-preact`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
// package.json
"preact": "^11"   // a minor that moved Preact's internal useId mask
```

```tsx prefer
// package.json
"preact": "11.0.1"  // a version @rivetjs/bridge-preact supports
```

## When it is reported

Server render (`@rivetjs/bridge-preact/server`). The adapter makes `useId` ids unique per island through Preact's internal `useId` mask (no public option exists); its first render checks that the installed Preact still reads it. If not, every Preact island fails to render (RV2144 path) instead of silently emitting the same ids in every island.
